title: Flax in the Field
offer: Linen is softer than wool on the skin. Plant flax on your farm! When it blooms blue and is ripe, bring me two crates.

steps.say: Flax seed in the field. In a few days, it blooms blue.
Your own flax! I will make you linen shirts, soft as a cloud.

fact: Flax was soaked, beaten and combed for weeks before it could be spun into linen.
